dedupe_keys.name: robine at austrian energy climate hazard indicators

description: The ROBINE-AT team publishes Austrian climate hazards selected for energy-infrastructure analysis. The Zenodo description identifies forty-one indicators for historical warming level 1.0 and future levels 2.0, 3.0 and 4.0 degrees, based on six downscaled and bias-adjusted climate projections. Maps have about one-kilometre spatial resolution and address heat, cold, wind calm and storms, extreme rain, flood, drought, lightning and wildfire. The repository lists map and table ZIP archives plus a variable-and-unit dictionary. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. The maps can overlay power-line or generation assets for exposure and resilience scenarios; model-pypsa is a separate power-network simulation context. A caveat is that climate hazard indicators do not themselves encode line fragility, turbine output or outage probability. Each warming level and indicator needs the correct projection interpretation. Own metadata and the manifest were checked without downloading grids or testing Austrian asset overlays.
